tasks.short: Initiate, facilitate, and moderate classroom discussions.

steps.what: Read the question that opens this classroom discussion
Initiate, facilitate, and moderate classroom discussions
Decide which point of the classroom discussions she closes

tasks.design: She reads the opening question, then initiates, facilitates and moderates the classroom discussions in the room. She decides which point to close. Nothing is recorded and nothing is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The discussion is live speech with students, so there was no separable record to take out of the hour.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new shortens the talk in the room. The discussion is still the work.
tasks.still_hard: Who speaks, which point to press, and when to close have no rule that can stand in for her.
tasks.human_edge: The discussion is hers. Opening, moderating and closing stay with her.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still leads the classroom discussions, and she gains no decision right she did not already have.

reach.learn: A blank opening question is stated in the room. This task does not keep a written discussion.

evidence.claim: Classroom discussion is live speech, so a saved note would not shorten the hour in the room.

assumptions: No structured input is required, because nothing is generated.
If the opening question is blank, she states it in the room during the discussion.
A later written summary is outside these shares. She does not store a second copy here.
Upkeep hours are zero because no note is kept and there is no exception queue.
unknowns: Whether a written summary of the discussion is required later is something only this teacher can confirm.
research_questions: Does this classroom discussion include a written summary inside the same task, or only the talk?

incremental.description: No note is kept, so there is no exception queue. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A year of weekly classroom discussions stays in the room. She still opens, moderates and closes them. Nothing in this task is filed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the laboratory procedure for this session
Decide when a student must stop the laboratory bench

tasks.design: She reads the laboratory procedure, supervises the students at the bench, and decides when a student must stop. The safety call stays hers. Nothing is generated and nothing is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision is physical presence and a safety call, so there was no clerical slice to take out of the session.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new watches the bench for her. The supervision is still the work.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a student is working safely has no rule that can stand in for her in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The bench is hers. The procedure, the supervision and the stop call stay with her.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still supervises the laboratory, and she gains no decision right she did not already have.

reach.task: Set the laboratory procedure for this session
reach.learn: The stop call stays with the teacher. This task does not file an incident note.

evidence.claim: Laboratory supervision is physical presence and a safety judgement, so a generated procedure would not shorten the bench.

assumptions: No structured input is required, because nothing is generated.
If the procedure is blank, she states the limits in the room before the students start.
A later written incident note is outside these shares. She does not store a second copy here.
Upkeep hours are zero because no note is kept and there is no exception queue.
unknowns: Whether an incident note is required after a stopped bench is something only the laboratory lead can confirm.
research_questions: Does supervising this laboratory include a written incident note inside the same task?

incremental.description: No note is kept, so there is no exception queue. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A year of laboratory sessions stays at the bench. She still reads the procedure, supervises the students and makes the stop call. Nothing in this task is filed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read current literature, talk with colleagues, and join conferences.

steps.what: Read current literature in this field
Talk with colleagues about developments in the field
Join the professional conference on this field

tasks.design: She reads the current literature, talks with colleagues about developments in the field, and joins the professional conference. No summary is drafted and no reading note is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The reading, the colleague talk and the conference are the work of keeping abreast, so a summary would replace them rather than shorten a slice.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new reads the science for her. The literature and the conference stay hers.
tasks.still_hard: Which development matters for her teaching has no rule that can stand in for the reading.
tasks.human_edge: The reading is hers. The colleague talk and the conference stay in her own words.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still reads, talks and attends, and she gains no decision right she did not already have.

reach.task: Talk through a development in this field
reach.learn: The reading stays with the teacher. This task does not file a reading note or send a registration.

evidence.claim: Keeping abreast is the reading, the colleague talk and the conference, so a generated summary would replace that work rather than shorten a separable step.

assumptions: No structured input is required, because nothing is generated.
Colleague talk is inside the organisation. A conference registration sent outside would be a separate step, and it is not part of these shares.
A later reading note is outside these shares. She does not store a second copy here.
Upkeep hours are zero because no summary is produced and there is no exception queue.
unknowns: Which conferences this teacher must attend this year is something only she can confirm.
research_questions: Is conference registration a separate send, or does she only attend?

incremental.description: No summary is produced, so there is no exception queue. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A year of reading, colleague talks and conferences stays with her. She still reads the literature and still attends. Nothing in this task is filed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain student attendance records, grades, and other required records.

steps.what: Read the class list and the grades already set
State attendance and the required record for each student
Copy the stated attendance and grade into the student record
Check the copy matches her stated grade and changes none
Write the accepted attendance and grade into the official student record

tasks.design: She states attendance and the already-set grade for each student. A copy places only those fields and does not wait for its own check. She checks the copy changed no mark. Only the accepted set is written once into the official student record in {OTHER}. A rejection writes nothing. She does not type that record herself.
tasks.previous_blocker: The second publication of an already-set grade was typed again by hand into the student record, because the course list and the official record did not share one write.
tasks.enabler_now: A field copy can place stated attendance and an already-set grade into the official student record. The grade itself is still set in the grading task.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a student was present, and whether the copied mark is the one she stated, stay her call. A blank mark is not invented here.
tasks.human_edge: The mark is hers. She states attendance, and she rejects a copy that changed a grade.
tasks.altitude: She still states attendance and still checks the copy. Only the second writing of an accepted attendance and grade record leaves her week. She gains no right to set a mark.

reach.task: Hold the official student record other staff rely on
reach.learn: Only an accepted attendance and grade set is written. A copy that changed a mark is not written.

evidence.claim: Copying a stated attendance mark and an already-set grade into the official record is a transfer and does not set or change the mark.
Radboud's Brightspace grades must always also be published in OSIRIS.

assumptions: The grade is set in the grading task. This task does not re-mark. Fields before the copy: student id, present or absent, the already-set grade, and the required-record name. The class list comes from the {LMS}. If a mark is blank she does not invent it here. A blank student id means no copy.

Try a native publish from the {LMS} first. The copy runs only where that publish does not write the official student record. It places only the stated fields, does not compose a mark, and does not wait for its own check.

The official student record is {OTHER}, the student-records system. A change to the copy voids the acceptance. A rejection writes nothing, and she does not type a second copy. Records are not uploaded to an external model, and no staff-speed view is built.
Upkeep hours are zero because a mismatched copy is dropped in the check. There is no later rewrite queue.
unknowns: Which extra required-record fields the official student record demands beyond student id, present or absent, the already-set grade, and the record name.
research_questions: Which required-record fields are mandatory in the official student record beyond attendance and the already-set grade?

already_counted.description: The check that the copy matches her stated grade and changes none, already counted in the review step before the write.

incremental.description: A mismatched copy is dropped in the check. There is no later rewrite queue, so upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a year of one short class whose marks rarely need a second publication, so she often rejects a mismatch and the official write rarely fires. High: a year of weekly classes whose accepted attendance and grades are written once into the official record. She still states the marks and still checks that none changed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The classroom discussion, the laboratory supervision, the reading and the conference, and the grade itself stay in her week. Only the second writing of an accepted attendance and grade record leaves it. She gains no new decision right.
skills_to_grow: State attendance and the already-set grade before any copy.
Reject a copy that changed a mark.
Leave the discussion, the bench, and the literature in her own words.
role.ambitious_version: The week does not grow. She does not take on more discussions, more benches, more conferences or more classes because of this.
